narrative.overview: A light, image-led gallery with pale green-tinted surfaces, restrained controls, and colored specimens for empty collections.
dos: Reuse the existing palette and rounded surfaces.
Preserve full-image proportions in detail views and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Do not present empty-style specimens as saved image references.
